Signed Lefschetz orbit enumeration gives H2 rational rank 1; odd-prime averaging exact as |D4|=8 invertible, excluding odd torsion. Simple connectivity eliminates H1, mod2 H2 dimension one excludes 2-primary torsion there, and free cellular H3 with zero rational rank vanishes. Therefore integral homology of S2; Hurewicz and simply connected homology Whitehead yield S2 homotopy type. Claims actual geometric quotient not Borel quotient.
